profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary: Results driven Senior Software Engineer & Technical Leader with 20+ years of experience in embedded systems, mission critical software, and product innovation. Recognized for making things happen through exceptional troubleshooting, design, and debugging skills. Adept at leading cross functional teams, streamlining processes, and delivering innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. Proven record of reducing costs, accelerating system performance, and defining software life cycle processes that elevate organizational efficiency. A collaborative team player committed to quality, technical excellence, and people centered leadership.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Danfoss is the leading manufacturer of oil free compressors and is the pioneer of the Danfoss Turbocor® compressor - the world’s first oil-free magnetic bearing compressor for the HVAC industry.

Directed software engineering team, roadmap planning, and process definition.
Delivered embedded compressor control solutions with advanced fast start capability (2 min → 30 sec recovery).
Implemented TT Softstart software in collaboration with EE lead engineer, an inrush current control product saving ~$1M/year in inventory costs.
Led full software life cycle development for TI DSP/MCU platforms.
Implemented valve control motor interface for compressor derating.
Supported production systems, regression testing, and customer acceptance.
